family.description: This entry represents a domain found in prokaryotic alpha-amylase and 4-alpha-glucanotransferase. It is adjacent to the C-terminal domain ([pfam:PF09095]). This domain adopts an immunoglobulin/ albumin-binding domain-like fold, with a bundle of three alpha-helices. Their function is, as yet, unknown [[cite:PUB00014074]].
family.name: Alpha-amylase/4-alpha-glucanotransferase, middle domain
